notes: Core team says it as one word, "midemproxy" (middle syllable reduces to schwa); Hils says it at youtu.be/hPuOtJbxJT8 0:15. Outsiders default to spelling out M-I-T-M — "mitm now stands for mitmproxy in the middle".
Rust container runtime replacing Docker Desktop/OrbStack (runkiri.com). Name is the Igbo word ntakịrị, "small", per the creator README — so KEE-ree, not KIH-ree or KERRY.
ESP32 language/runtime by ex-V8/Dart engineers. Asked how to say it, the creator answered: "It's from Austin Powers. 'toit like a tiger'" — rhymes with height, not French "twah".
Mistral's own nickname for Mistral Large 4 (1T params): "Unofficially ML4, very officially: le Chonk." Le as in the sibling product Le Chat (luh), matching the meme spelling chonk.
Pipelined Relational Query Language — pronounced "prequel", per the project itself, not P-R-Q-L.
